subject: Planned deprecation of rwd-beta-2 endpoint — timeline, comms, and exception process
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Planned deprecation of rwd-beta-2 endpoint — initial timeline and asks

Team,

We need to lock the deprecation plan for the rwd-beta-2 generation endpoint. Product wants to retire beta-2 because it will no longer receive bug fixes and it complicates routing with the new rwd-llm-v2 family. High-level asks:

- Engineering: confirm safe-off timeline and compatibility gaps (API params that will change, latency differences).
- Docs/DevX: a comms draft + SDK changelog + migration guide.
- Sales/CS: list of active enterprise customers that require extended support / exceptions and whether there's an associated commitment (SLA/contract).
- Security: any data-retention or audit considerations for preserved KV cache state.

Target dates suggestion (draft):
1) Public deprecation notice: 2026-11-09
2) Last new requests accepted to beta-2: 2026-12-07
3) Read-only mode / forced migration window: 2027-01-15 to 2027-02-15
4) Shutdown: 2027-02-16

Please respond with known blockers or customer exceptions by EOD 2026-10-28. I'll collate and share a finalized comms plan.

-Markus
VP Product — Redwood Inference

---
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation of rwd-beta-2 endpoint — initial timeline and asks

Thanks Markus — quick engineering update:

- Compatibility: rwd-llm-v2 is a drop-in for most customers but there are three param behaviors to call out: sampling defaults (temp/top_p), structured-tool-calling hooks (minor signature change), and a header for KV cache migration. We'll document compatibility shims in the SDK.
- Effort: Removing serving path and telemetry for beta-2 requires a 4-week rolling deploy plus a one-week verification window. With current sprint velocity we can meet your shutdown target (2027-02-16) if no exceptions are requested.
- Migration tooling: we'll provide a telemetry-driven rollout that highlights request failures post-switch; however, for enterprise customers doing in-proc inference there will be manual steps.

Blockers: two flagged items — BrightHealth runs a custom post-processing layer that relies on an undocumented tokenization quirk; they will need a migration window + support. Also, there is an internal eval harness that expects the old logits ordering (used by a partner POC) — we'll need an exception.

I propose we prepare a short exception SLA (30 days extended support, assigned eng on-call) for approved accounts.

-Dev

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation of rwd-beta-2 endpoint — initial timeline and asks

Sales/CS input:

- Active enterprise customers who may request exceptions: BrightHealth (Alice), Acme Retail (procurement), and a midsize fintech (NimblePay). I've added BH-9812 to the related_links.
- For BH: they start a seasonal intake in mid-Jan and cannot have model diffs during that period. They'll request a 90-day exception window unless we can guarantee equivalence.
- We'll need a clearly templated exception-request form (fields: account, reason, requested window, commercial impact) so AMs can submit cleanly. I've attached an example template.

I'll coordinate with AMs to collect a prioritized exception list by 2026-10-30.

-Laura
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: exception-request-template.docx

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation of rwd-beta-2 endpoint — initial timeline and asks

Security note:

- If we enable any extended runtime for beta-2 customers, we must ensure audit logs and request retention follow existing compliance boundaries (SOC 2 perspective). Any bespoke shim or tokenization workaround must be gated via a feature flag and logged.
- For BrightHealth: they asked about whether cached KV state persists after shutdown. Short answer: we can snapshot and provide a time-bound export, but we need legal sign-off for retention beyond policy.

Action: please copy security on all exception approvals so we can attach the required evidence and retain the audit trail.

-Evelyn
Head of Security & Compliance

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@brighthealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation of rwd-beta-2 endpoint — timeline, comms, and exception process

Alice — quick outreach on behalf of Product & Engineering: we're planning to deprecate the rwd-beta-2 endpoint and are aware BrightHealth has special processing that may be impacted. Could you confirm the following so we can scope an exception if needed:

1) Do you rely on any undocumented tokenization/ordering behavior?
2) Are you able to run a dry migration with our staging v2 endpoint between Dec 1–Dec 15?
3) If we offer a 60–90 day extended support window, would that be sufficient for your season in mid-Jan?

We can assign an eng on-call and run a joint testing session if you confirm.

Thanks,
Laura

---
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@brighthealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation of rwd-beta-2 endpoint — timeline, comms, and exception process

Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up. Quick replies: 

1) We do rely on a tokenization ordering quirk in a legacy pipeline. It's not documented but we can reproduce testcases.
2) We can run the dry migration between Dec 1–Dec 10 and will prioritize the tests.
3) Given our Jan season, a 90-day exception (shutdown moved to mid-May for our traffic) would be ideal, but we'll accept 60 days if engineering can provide dedicated support and a rollback plan.

We'll fill the exception template and send it back by Nov 4. Please advise point-of-contact for the engineering assistance.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Head of ML Engineering — BrightHealth
